title: Original WA ordered cache and expiring suggestion cache state
oracle: Literal reviewed eviction/refresh/delete/clear, nullish-oldest and TTL boundary sequences plus an independent ordered-list reference model for generated WALRUMap commands. WALRUMap reads do not promote; writes promote and capacity truncates ordinary-key histories. Fixed null/undefined oldest sequences characterize skipped eviction and over-capacity state without replacing it with an ideal LRU contract. Actual WWAICache uses capacity20, TTL300000ms and integer-second WATimeUtils.unixTime; reads promote order without refreshing timestamp. Actual WATimeUtils.setClockSkew/getClockSkew exercise synthetic +301/-301 second shifts with restoration; these are explicit source inputs, not observed server delivery. No cache/time implementation is mocked. Version2 adds actual realm-retained object keys/values, aliases, equal-shaped distinct objects and array identities. A separate ordered list of integer identity tokens models generated key/value histories; token equality is independent of serialized object shape. Actual returned suggestion arrays are retained and compared by strict identity across repeated reads, empty/replacement writes, capacity promotion and lazy TTL expiration. Native Array.pop/push invoked on the actual returned array characterizes caller mutation; no callback, cache or object-key implementation is injected.

trials.inputAndCapacityDomains: Unbounded; finite capacities and deterministic histories are characterization only
trials.ttlQuantization: Integer-second time makes age300000ms valid (strict > expiration);300999ms clock offset is still age300000, and301000 expires. Clock rollback yields negative age and stays live.

referenceExpansion.seed: Object-key LCG0x17d3c9ab xor capacity xor (page*65537); suggestion commands use fixed modular indices

exclusions: No supported gate reads found across all11present original dependency modules; missing cr6640 source remains a conservative closure gap, so no complete configuration-independence claim
WALRUMap selected leaf closure has no dependencies or gates; application cache source plus WATimeUtils/Promise/WAHex/logger closure is included independently of called-export reachability
Explicit cr6640:null fixture chooses actual original Promise fallback; original substitution and bundle bootstrap remain unproven. No cache, clock helper or application constants are replaced
No timers, network, background expiry, provider service or user session is exercised. Expiry is lazy on reads under explicit clock controls

Version2 covers six retained ordinary object-key tokens, alias reads/writes/deletion, equal-shaped distinct keys, returned value identity and reuse after eviction/clear. Symbol keys, proxies, adversarial prototype mutation and signed negative-zero transport remain unsupported/unexercised.
Capacity/input/time domains and command sequences are unbounded. Six capacities,24generated LRU pages and four application pages are bounded characterization, not all possible histories
Nullish-oldest eviction and colon-concatenated application key collisions are actual-source observations, not corrected desired behavior or general security conclusions
Application cache has no public clear/delete API; fresh module scenarios and expired-read deletion are covered without inventing reset operations
Suggestion values are synthetic stored data. Suggestion generation, consumers, AI transport/provider integration and product UI behavior are not covered
Alternative variants, containers, production scheduling, account/device state, real provider graphs and named-library parity remain unexercised

Reference histories are bounded source observations, not all key/value identities or lifecycles. Objects originate from the actual cache get after storing synthetic seed values, and all native object/array references remain inside the worker realm. Ordinary JSON equality is not substituted for identity.
